what_happened: Full general-gluing construction (union domain, left-biased dite states, 4-way respects_task split, convexity of the union, both reading equations, both restriction identities, uniqueness via partialHistory_ext, and the packaged ExistsUnique) compiled on the first corrected probe pass with every declaration measuring [propext, Quot.sound] -- choice-free, matching Sheaf.lean's and Ray.lean's profile. Research therefore hands the planner a verified construction, not a sketch.

Lean cannot eliminate the union domain's Prop-valued Or into the WorldState Type, so the glued states function needs a DecidablePred hypothesis on one side's domain; the choice-free pin rmk:choice demands rules out Classical.propDecidable, which would reinstate Classical.choice. This is an encoding hypothesis the paper's statement does not carry and must be recorded explicitly in the docstring as a Lean-constructивity artifact rather than a mathematical choice principle.

Research round left a fully verified, warning-free, choice-free probe (gluing-probe.lean, exit 0 under lake env lean) covering every deliverable. Planning was transcription plus gate sequencing rather than design, so the plan carries no unverified proof step.

Research report states partialHistory_ext has 'all four existing uses'. Re-derived at plan time: 13 call sites across 5 files (Behavior.lean 3, Sheaf.lean 4, Directed.lean 2, Determinism.lean 3, BehSeparatedness.lean 1), plus 2 markdown README mentions. Conclusion (relocation is call-site-neutral) still holds -- all 5 files resolve the name through FormalSystem.Semantics, confirmed by namespace inspection -- but the count is corrected in the plan as a Scope Hypothesis.

plan-file-scope-harvest.sh's generated-surface append stage revealed a gate the research report did not name: check-module-invariants.sh's INV check FAILs on a stale '<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: inventory -->' block, and five such blocks carry line counts for files this task edits (FormalSystem/README.md loose rows for Semantics.lean and the generated root, plus the Presheaf/, PlusLanguage/, OpenLanguage/ and HybridLanguage/ blocks). Plan patched: Phases 1, 4 and 6 each regenerate with 'check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory' and verify with '--emit-inventory --check'; Phase 6 also runs typst-sync-check.sh.

Wrote Phase 2's new FormalSystem/Semantics/Gluing.lean before closing Phase 1, so Phase 1's '--emit-inventory --check exits 0' criterion reported one INV problem (Gluing.lean live with no hand-maintained Semantics/README row) that belongs to Phase 4. Phase 1's own generated blocks were confirmed current; the row lands in Phase 4 as planned.

Plan Phase 6 expected no edit in this task to move a count carried by typst/generated/status.typ. It does: formalsystem-line-count is a whole-tree live line count, so every .lean line-count change in this task moves it, and the pre-commit typst-sync-check Check 2 gate blocks the commit until status.typ is regenerated. Remedied per the plan's own instruction (typst-sync-check.sh --fix, staged with the phase commit) rather than hand-editing or bypassing. Expect the same at every subsequent phase commit.

The probe transcribed clean, but the library build (unlike the probe's lake env lean run) fires linter.unusedDecidableInType on gluing_clause and gluing_clause_of_overlap: the DecidablePred instance is absent from the ExistsUnique statement, which is all that linter reads, while the proof needs it to exhibit convexGlue. The linter's suggested remedy (classical) is exactly the escape plan Decision 2 rejects, and omit is refused for a referenced section variable, so a scoped 'set_option linter.unusedDecidableInType false in' was used on both, following the existing precedent in RaySummary/Realize.lean, with a comment recording why. Build is now warning-free.

All 21 new declarations measured choice-free on the first build: Classical.choice appears in none. Three declarations the plan's carried table did not cover (pastRay_isConvex, futRay_isConvex, decPastRay) measure [propext] alone, i.e. one axiom fewer than the table's catch-all row predicted; the docstring table was rewritten to the measured values rather than the carried ones.

Phase 6's docstring-only citation edits were applied to seven modules while the Phase 4 aggregator build was still running, so that build's verdict is stale evidence for those files. The edits are comment-only and cannot change elaboration, but the covering check was re-established by the full unscoped build at Phase 6 rather than relied on from the interleaved run.

dispatch_seq 12 was interrupted by a dead session; took over and found phase 4/5/6 source edits already applied but uncommitted in the working tree (Semantics.lean import+docstring, Semantics/README.md row, C14 heredoc pair, theorem-index row, all 10 citation sites). Resumed by auditing those edits rather than redoing them; mk_all, inventory regeneration, commits and the gate set were still outstanding.

Plan Phase 6 predicted no edit in this task would move any count typst/generated/status.typ carries, naming only its axiom-constructor, rule-constructor and sorry counts. It also carries formalsystem-line-count, which this task's +39 docstring/import lines DID move (354743 -> 354782); the pre-commit typst-sync-check gate blocked the first .lean commit until status.typ was regenerated with --fix. Remedy applied; status.typ committed as its own Phase 4 sub-step ahead of the aggregator hunk so the shared-territory touch stayed one reviewable commit.

The full build-enabled check-module-invariants.sh run surfaced three failures the plan did not anticipate, all attributable to this task. (i) C15: Gluing.lean and Semantics/README.md cite rmk:choice by name, and rmk:choice had no KNOWN-ANCHORS row in docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md -- a file the plan's Non-Goals explicitly excluded on the strength of Decision 8, which reasoned only about app:gluing's own row and not about the second anchor the choice-free deliverable obliges citing. (ii) C15: gluing_clause's own doc comment carried no 'Paper:' line, which every docs/theorem-index.md row's declaration must have; the Phase 5 task list specified the index row but not the matching docstring line. (iii) C35: the citation manifest recorded pre-relocation line spans for PartialHistory, IsTotal and WorldHistory, drifted by Phase 1's partialHistory_ext relocation; fixed by python3 scripts/export-lean-citations.py. C14 itself PASSED on the first attempt with both new pins at the carried value [propext, Quot.sound].

C14 passed on the FIRST attempt with both new pins at exactly the value the research report measured and the plan carried, [propext, Quot.sound], and lean_verify independently agreed on all five checked declarations including the [propext] value for isConvex_union. The plan's transcription-not-discovery premise held: no proof step needed reworking, and all 21 planned declarations were present and correctly named. The matched-heredoc alignment hazard the plan flagged as the phase's only real risk did not materialise.
